item.title: Clearfield Wins D9 AA Team Wrestling Title
item.description: BROOKVILLE – The Clearfield Bison wrestling team won the District 9 AA Team Wrestling Championships on Saturday at Brookville High School, earning a trip to the PIAA AA State Team Wrestling Championships.
